findings.result: The Belfer Center lists Audrey Lee as an alumna (former member of the Energy Technology Innovation Policy project, co-authoring energy RD&D budget analyses). Seed affiliation.
Sunrun: Audrey Lee ran Sunrun's Energy Services group (ESAL 2019; NER interview 2020).
California Public Utilities Commission: Audrey Lee advised the president of the CPUC.
BART Environmental Justice Commission: Audrey Lee served on the commission.
Clean Energy for Biden: Audrey Lee served as co-chair (2020).
ArcLight Clean Transition Corp: Audrey Lee was a board director of this clean-energy SPAC (2020).

The Belfer ETIP energy-innovation researcher and the ESAL/NER energy-policy executive are treated as the same person on the basis of the matching specialty trajectory (Princeton PhD in electrical engineering, DOE Policy Office/Brookhaven energy analysis, national energy-regulation profile); confidence 0.9, not merged with any other Audrey Lee.

data.method: Repository search; Brave web search; direct fetch of the Belfer Center person page, the ESAL career interview, and the New Energy Risk interview; identity linked across sources by the distinctive Princeton-PhD energy-policy career profile; relations recorded for each corroborated public affiliation.
